facts.subject: system:Trionic7-ignition

value.combustion_feedback: Ion current across plug gaps supplies cylinder synchronization and misfire information

facts.notes: Ignition hardware is also part of engine feedback; a replacement must preserve these functions, beyond producing a spark.

facts.subject: system:Trionic7-ignition
facts.value: Red ignition discharge modules must not be used for the documented T7 application.
facts.notes: Module color warning is source-specific; verify correct part and engine application rather than treating any black housing as proof of authenticity.

facts.subject: system:Trionic7-knock-control
facts.value: The ignition module analyzes ion current across each plug gap; no conventional knock sensor is used.
facts.notes: Factory note requires the correct spark plug for the engine. Ignition substitutions must retain this sensing function.
